SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2 FROM ICOMTRXL TRXL, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND TRXL.TARGET = 'KRKDAC0001' AND TRXL.TARGET = IVHD.BUYER AND TRXL.KEY_1 = IVHD.INV_NO AND IVHD.INV_TYPE = '0' AND KEY_1 LIKE 'IV%' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND KEY_10 in (' ','A') UNION SELECT TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2 FROM ICOMTRXL TRXL, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND TRXL.TARGET = 'KRKDAC0001' AND TRXL.TARGET = PODT.BUYER AND TRXL.KEY_3 = PODT.PO_NO AND TRXL.KEY_4 = PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE ^= '0' AND KEY_1 LIKE 'IK%' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND KEY_10 in (' ','A')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '01' AS COMLTD ,'D4240' AS VSRNO ,PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION||IVDT.INV_NO AS SLNO ,SUBSTR(PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,1,8) AS SRNO ,SUBSTR(PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,9,2) AS SRNO1 ,SUBSTR(PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,1) AS XPLANT ,SUBSTR(PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION,2,1) AS DIV ,PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITNO ,nvl(trim(IFPO.DESCRIPTION),'.') AS ITNM ,nvl(trim(IFPO.SPECIFICATION),'.') AS SPEC ,nvl(PODT.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER ,PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS XUNIT ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,4)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,4)-1 )),' ') AS CLS ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,6) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5)-1 )),'.') AS XTYPE ,' ' AS GUBUN ,PODT.REF_PR_NO AS RQNO ,PRDT.REQ_USER_ID AS EMPNO ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,2)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,3) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,2)-1 )),'.') AS DEPT ,IVDT.INVOICE_DATE AS STDT ,IVDT.ADD_DATE AS PRTDT ,PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PQTY ,PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS XCOST ,PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PURNO ,PODT.RD_DATE AS PDUDT ,IVDT.INV_QTY AS AQTY ,' ' AS STCD ,'N' AS IFFLAG ,DECODE(IVDT.STATUS,'D','D','C') AS CDFLAG from icomivdt ivdt, icompodt podt, icomprdt prdt, if_podt ifpo where ivdt.buyer = '$G_RS.TARGET$' and ivdt.inv_no = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' and ivdt.inv_seq= '$G_RS.KEY_2$' and ivdt.buyer = podt.buyer and ivdt.po_no = podt.po_no and ivdt.po_seq= podt.po_seq and podt.buyer = prdt.buyer and podt.pr_no = prdt.pr_no and podt.pr_seq= prdt.pr_seq and prdt.buyer = ifpo.buyer and prdt.legacy_po_no = ifpo.legacy_po_no and prdt.legacy_po_seq= ifpo.legacy_po_seq and podt.process_type = '0' UNION ALL SELECT '01' AS COMLTD ,'D4240' AS VSRNO ,PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION||IVDT.INV_NO AS SLNO ,SUBSTR(PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,1,8) AS SRNO ,SUBSTR(PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,9,2) AS SRNO1 ,SUBSTR(PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,1) AS XPLANT ,SUBSTR(PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION,2,1) AS DIV ,PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITNO ,nvl(trim(IFPO.DESCRIPTION),'.') AS ITNM ,nvl(trim(IFPO.SPECIFICATION),'.') AS SPEC ,nvl(PODT.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER ,replace(replace(PODT.UNIT_MEASURE,'BOX','BX'),'SET','ST') AS XUNIT ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,4)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,4)-1 )),' ') AS CLS ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,6) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,5)-1 )),'.') AS XTYPE ,' ' AS GUBUN ,PODT.REF_PR_NO AS RQNO ,PRDT.REQ_USER_ID AS EMPNO ,nvl(trim(SUBSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,2)+1,INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,3) -INSTRB(PRDT.IV_COLUMN,'^',1,2)-1 )),'.') AS DEPT ,IVDT.INV_DATE AS STDT ,IVDT.ADD_DATE AS PRTDT ,PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PQTY ,PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS XCOST ,PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PURNO ,PODT.RD_DATE AS PDUDT ,IVDT.INV_QTY AS AQTY ,' ' AS STCD ,'N' AS IFFLAG ,DECODE(IVDT.STATUS,'D','D','C') AS CDFLAG from wmsivdt ivdt, icompodt podt, icomprdt prdt, if_podt ifpo where ivdt.buyer = '$G_RS.TARGET$' and ivdt.inv_no = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' and ivdt.inv_seq= '$G_RS.KEY_2$' and ivdt.buyer = podt.buyer and ivdt.po_no = podt.po_no and ivdt.po_seq= podt.po_seq and podt.buyer = prdt.buyer and podt.pr_no = prdt.pr_no and podt.pr_seq= prdt.pr_seq and prdt.buyer = ifpo.buyer and prdt.legacy_po_no = ifpo.legacy_po_no and prdt.legacy_po_seq= ifpo.legacy_po_seq ORDER BY SLNO,SRNO,SRNO1
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND KEY_10 in (' ','A')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND KEY_10 in (' ','A')
